scene: The sparkling blue sock reveals a transit map tucked inside.
picture: A flat side view of the night street outside the laundromat exit. Far left sits an idling blue harbour ferry along a pier. The player stands centre holding a glowing blue sock, wearing a yellow raincoat and green boots, carrying a red umbrella. Up high hangs a yellow cable car. Far right shows a glowing subway entrance.
shown: a blue harbour ferry idling at a low pier on the far left
a dangling yellow cable car hanging from cables up high
a tiled subway entrance with illuminated turnstiles on the far right
